classroom_exchanges.question: Can the next coin state depend on more than the current face?
classroom_exchanges.answer_summary: Yes. Enlarge the state to include the required history; one previous face gives four ordered-pair states.

classroom_exchanges.question: Could the nonreversible graph be allowed for particle probabilities?
classroom_exchanges.answer_summary: Not as a fundamental deterministic classical law; statistical mechanics starts from mechanics, while quantum mechanics has a later analog of reversible evolution.
